hook: The Diamond Necklace She Never Wanted
text: Two Paris jewellers made a necklace of hundreds of diamonds, and offered it to the Queen. She said no. Then a clever swindler convinced a cardinal that the Queen secretly wanted it. She brought him forged letters, and arranged a meeting at night, in a dark grove at Versailles, with a young woman who only looked like the Queen. The necklace vanished. The Queen was innocent. But many people never believed it.
